task.intent: Read config.toml from the local workspace and report its contents.

assistant_behavior.summary: Assistant says it will open the file, then states it cannot read local files and asks the user to provide the contents.
After the user explicitly asks to execute, assistant again states that file tools are unavailable and suggests a PowerShell command instead of issuing a tool call.
After another explicit execute request, assistant again reports that file tools are unavailable and finishes without a tool call.

expected.then: Return the file contents after successful tool execution.

notes: This evidence proves the observed RelayRouter/OpenCode route did not expose or produce a usable file-tool call in this session.
It does not by itself prove whether the limitation originates in RelayRouter, the selected RelayRouter route/model, protocol translation, or another adapter layer.
The A6api run is a positive control demonstrating that the same OpenCode client can emit and complete a read tool call in the same workspace class.
